scope: EXPLORATORY DEVELOPMENT only; not fresh validation

selection.rule: First48 image-id-sorted oldDEVphotos; all12 targets; fixed before v18 real inference
selection.thresholds: Exploratory within-pilot 5% negative FPR, not fresh validation

checkpoint_rule: Frozen final512updates; no retraining or checkpoint selection
metrics: Ranking AUROC and unthresholded localization; within-pilot5%absentFPR calibration is descriptive only
common_box_rule: Select highest-scoring proposal first, clip xyxy to the original image bounds for every method, then compute half-open IoU; raw box retained.
